title: You are the judge. Five souls. Twenty-five endings. One verdict waiting for you.
author: MrFaabry14
selftext:
Luce Spenta is a gothic psychological visual novel developed entirely by one person where you decide the fate of five condemned souls, and then face your own.

Almost a year after launch, this update finally makes the game feel like what I had in my head from the beginning. New visuals, new events, reworked presentation. It took longer than I expected, but I'm genuinely happy with where it landed.

If the game caught your attention, you can find it here:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4015120/Luce\_Spenta/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4015120/Luce_Spenta/)

*Note: AI-assisted tools were used in early development for visual assets. The current version is extensively reworked under my own artistic direction but it still is involved.*
